digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions workflow (_optionality.yml) and test suite coverage
propositions: The import-linter job in _optionality.yml consumes a concurrent slot against a GitHub Free org-wide cap of 20 total slots, while its test coverage is strictly dominated by the four test matrix cells in _build-and-test.yml.

Deletion of the import-linter job opens a gap: no existing test or script validates that tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py and tests/unit/test_optional.py remain collected by the default suite selection, making them vulnerable to accidental exclusion via marker, relocation, or filter additions.

A durable collection guard test must assert that exactly 9 test items are collected from the two files under the default selection (-m "not integration and not external") to prevent future regressions.
The collection guard test must fail if a marker (file-level pytestmark, decorator, or conftest-applied) is added that would exclude either file from the default suite.
